name: BSc Mining Engineering
description: This comprehensive degree covers all aspects of open‑pit and underground mining: rock mechanics, ventilation, mineral economics, and mine safety. Graduates are equipped for roles such as Mine Planner, Drill & Blast Engineer, and Production Supervisor. The programme includes a 12‑week industry internship.
entryRequirements: Full Grade 12 certificate with credits in Mathematics, Physics, and English.

name: Diploma in Mineral Processing
description: Learn the principles of crushing, grinding, flotation, leaching, and tailings management. This hands‑on diploma includes practical sessions in our pilot processing plant and a 6‑week attachment with a mining company.
entryRequirements: Grade 12 certificate with at least passes in Science and Mathematics.

name: Certificate in Environmental Management
description: A focused 1‑year certificate covering environmental impact assessment, waste management, and sustainable mining practices. Ideal for school leavers or industry workers seeking formal qualifications.
entryRequirements: Grade 12 certificate with any four subjects; no specific prerequisites.

name: BSc Computer Science
description: Explore software engineering, data science, and networking. Our labs are equipped with modern hardware and students undertake a capstone project in their final year. Career paths include Developer, Systems Analyst, and IT Consultant.
entryRequirements: Grade 12 certificate with credit in Mathematics and English.
